name: How can I make my new bathroom addition energy-efficient?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my new bathroom addition energy-efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enhance energy efficiency in your new bathroom addition, consider incorporating several key features. Opt for low-flow toilets and showerheads to reduce water consumption. Install LED lighting for lower electricity usage and longer lifespan. Choose an energy-efficient exhaust fan that is properly sized for the room. High-quality insulation in walls and ceilings, along with energy-efficient windows, will help maintain temperature and reduce heating or cooling costs. We can guide you in selecting sustainable options that meet your preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make your bathroom addition energy-efficient with low-flow fixtures, LED lighting, efficient exhaust fans, and good insulation.
